title: Structural Refactor Kit Store Domain Abstractions
description: Implement the refactor plan from semio-refactor-plan-kit-store.md: Define KitStore interface in semio/js as storage-agnostic contract, inject kitStore into Sketchpad, move all provider implementations to semio/studio, remove all engine-specific imports from semio/sketchpad. This is a structural refactor, not a rename exercise.
summary: Completed Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the KitStore structural refactor. Phase 1: Added KitStoreStatus, KitSyncState, KitStoreSnapshot types, KitStore interface, UndoableKitStore, BlobAssetStore, ObservablePathStore interfaces, InMemoryKitStore with command-stack undo/redo, 12 tests. Phase 2: Renamed KitStore class to CollaborativeKitStore (36 edits), Kit.tsx KitStore to KitAppStoreImpl (8 edits), CollaborativeKitStore implements KitStore interface, added kitStore prop to Sketchpad, wired through SketchpadScopeProvider to SketchpadStore constructor, SketchpadStore registers injected KitStore and forwards changes via getKitDiff, exported KitStore types from index.ts. Build clean, all 34 tests pass.
